name: Romance after dark
source:
Welcome to our noir blend of visual novel and adventure game!
In this story, you’ll play as Trevor, a once successful private investigator whose wretched life you’ll try to put back on the right track.
Use your detective hunches and interact with characters and objects, all the while making crucial choices that will lead you to one of ten endings.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1560790/Romance_after_dark/]Steam[/url]]
